scope: Epoch9 one source-frozen zero-shot three-way pretrained NLI model under unchanged context6, actual RuVector vs matched lexical/positional and same-excerpt Native104. Internal public ContractNLI pilot only.
data: Exactly48 previously project-model-unused officialtrain queries in16 new document groups,3 fixed hypotheses each. Exact future bank SHA must be bound before model choice and execution. No reuse of old confirmation96f018.

required.proper_loss_point_nonincrease: Primary Brier and NLL<=each of ALL3 controls+1e-12.
required.accuracy_supported_gain: Paired document-cluster percentile bootstrap95 lowerbound>0 versus EACH of ALL3 controls, including same-excerpt Native104.
required.proper_noninferiority_supported: Paired document-cluster bootstrap95 lowerbound>=-1e-12 for control-minus-primary Brier AND NLL versus EACH of ALL3 controls.
required.strict_proper_gain_matched: At least one point proper-loss gain>1e-12 versus EACH same-NLI lexical and positional control.
required.native_and_controls: Actual native ranking, source bank and saved vectors, exact shared model/tokenizer/packing/T1 across matched arms; excerpt104 receives exact primary excerpt+original question. No answer lookup or hidden fallback.
required.execution: Exact plan/model/dependency/data/receipts unchanged, CPU2/GPU0/paid0, at most2 nonretryable process phases each<=600s including initialization and bounded cleanup.

bootstrap.unit: 16 document groups, mean3 correlated query gains per doc; resample16groups with replacement, paired group draws across arms/metrics.
bootstrap.interval: Two-sided percentile2.5%,97.5%; frozen scorer uses index int(p*(draws-1)).
bootstrap.multiplicity: Nominal unadjusted exploratory intervals, no familywise/generalization/official SOTA claim. All comparisons disclosed.

failure: Any required gate failure rejects internal advancement. After any model attempt retire entire48 as permanently exposed; no posthoc policy/threshold/model choice, rescore-as-new-confirmation or retry.
official_scope: No generic submitted Native104/RRF10 replacement or official JevBench/LegalBench/ClaimBench score/rank without publisher-matched score/eligibility receipt.
